Good evening, passengers. This is an announcement for flight eight three two to New York. The gate is now gate twenty-two. It is not gate fourteen. Please go to gate twenty-two now. Boarding starts in thirty minutes. Please have your passport in your hand. If your seat is in row one to ten, you can board first. Thank you.

Good morning, Mister Luiz. This is the front desk. Your room is ready now. Your reservation is for twenty nights, and your room number is fourteen oh six. The key is here at the desk, with your name on it. Breakfast is from six thirty to ten, on the second floor. If you would like a wake-up call in the morning, please tell us the time. Have a very good stay.

Rodrigo arrived at the airport in New York in the morning. He showed his passport at passport control. Then he took a taxi to the hotel in Manhattan. At the front desk he said he had a reservation. Two minutes later the receptionist gave him the key to room fourteen oh six.
